title: Inventory and stabilize variant contracts with publish safeguards
creator: Lina Park
description: Objective: reduce regressions from variant drift by formalizing 'variant contracts' (a small set of canonical variant axes and widths that downstream components rely on), cleaning up auto-layout anomalies introduced by legacy instances, and adding pre-publish validations to the Figma library pipeline. This ticket covers inventory, mapping, light pruning (non-destructive where possible), renaming rules, and a gating check before library publish.
acceptance_criteria: Authoritative inventory CSV listing component family, variant axes, instance-count, and top 3 dependent files
Mapping document with canonical variant axes and proposed renames reviewed and approved by PM and engineering
Automated pre-publish linter fails CI for: duplicate variant keys, conflicting auto-layout constraints, and missing semantic tokens
A staged publish run that migrates <=30 low-risk instances per batch with rollback plan
Design sign-off on final naming and migration checklist; publish gating in place for next library release
updates: 2026-02-18 Lina Park: Ticket created after component audit revealed 14 component families with inconsistent variant axes and 87 instances with broken auto-layout after token rename. Draft inventory exported from Figma plugin (figma-inspector) added to Drive.

2026-02-24 Marco Ruiz: Performed sampling across core products (Console, Hosted API docs). Found a pattern where "compact/normal/large" axes had mixed semantics (padding vs density). Proposed canonical axes: density, state, tone. Added initial mapping doc to Confluence.

2026-03-01 Design review (Lina, Marco, Priya): Agreed to avoid force-pruning variants that are referenced by more than 50 instances. Action: create 'sparse-variant-prune' script to tag low-usage variants and add a deprecation notice to instances instead of deleting.

2026-03-05 Eng sync (Marco, Ravi): Engineering will add a pre-publish linter that checks for: variant key collisions, inconsistent auto-layout axes (mixed horizontal/vertical passes), and missing semantic token references. Ravi opened PR #212 for linter integration; CI hook added in staging pipeline.

2026-03-09 Lina: Ran a dry migration for 'Button' family across a single repo. Results: 12/120 instances required manual adjustment (mostly nested frames with pinned elements). Documented manual remediation steps in the mapping doc.

2026-03-12 Marco: Canaries scheduled: three nightly batches (30 instances each) starting 2026-03-15. Added rollback playbook and created a dashboard (Console > DS migrations) to track affected files and regressions.
Notes: Design advocate will pair with solutions engineer during first canary. PM requested a short user-facing changelog for any visible component density changes.
next_steps: Finalize mapping doc and get PM approval by 2026-03-13
Merge linter PR and enable pre-publish gating in staging by 2026-03-14
Run first canary batch on 2026-03-15 with on-call design/eng coverage
Collect regressions and iterate on pruning threshold (currently set to max 50 instances)
